facts.fact: Cape Verde's Decreto-Lei n.º 33/2007, published in the Boletim Oficial on 24 September 2007 and in force the day after, sets the legal regime for electronic signatures, certification entities and electronic contracting, and repeals Decreto-Lei 49/2003.
facts.system: Decreto-Lei n.º 33/2007 (assinatura electrónica, certificação e contratação electrónica)

note: Article 89 orders a regulating decree within 150 days but the text does not say one was made, and no accreditation is recorded in it.
